title: Delightful evening!  Fine dining experience in a beautiful home with gracious host.
text:
Liti and her husband Alberto were delightful hosts who created a wonderful experience for us.  They are very gracious, and their home is beautiful.  Upon entering their home, we knew it would be a special evening.  They served us Jerez and tasty appetizers to start.  Liti prepared a delicious meal of salad, paella and dessert. Each course was so yummy that we overate!   I am gluten free and was given delicious bread to enjoy with the meal. The wine was perfect for the meal and of high quality.  This is a detail that assured us that they are attentive to the complete fine dining experience.  
I
author: annefU9888XW
